tagline: Prime real estate for sustainable value creation
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross rental income like-for-like is the main driver of operational performance for Colonial, reflecting its ability to increase rents across its prime portfolio, notably in Paris. It is a key indicator of internal growth dynamics in the listed real estate sector.

kpis.name: Gross rental income like-for-like growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in rental revenues on a comparable basis, excluding foreign exchange effects and new assets.
kpis.description: 6% like-for-like growth in gross rental income, driven by strong momentum in Paris (+9%).
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth among the highest in the sector

kpis.name: Rental release spread
kpis.explanation: Difference between new signed rents and previous contracts for re-leased spaces.
kpis.description: Average spread of +8% at group level, reaching +16% in Paris, demonstrating strong demand for prime assets.
kpis.signal: Enhanced pricing power in the rental market

kpis.name: Occupancy rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leased space in the real estate portfolio.
kpis.description: Overall occupancy rate of 92%, up 62 basis points versus September 2025.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate with continuous improvement

kpis.name: Gross asset value like-for-like growth
kpis.explanation: Change in the value of real estate assets on a comparable basis.
kpis.description: 3% like-for-like growth in gross asset value, supported by rising rents and portfolio quality.

kpis.name: Loan to value ratio
kpis.explanation: Net debt outstanding divided by asset value.
kpis.description: Pro forma LTV at 37.1%, down 105 basis points, thanks to the disposal program.
kpis.signal: Ongoing deleveraging with strengthened balance sheet structure

kpis.name: Disposals executed
kpis.explanation: Amount of assets sold under the divestment program.
kpis.description: €300 million in disposals realized since the start of the year, of which €240 million in Paris (83 Marceau).
kpis.signal: Accelerated execution of the deleveraging program

kpis.name: EPRA earnings
kpis.explanation: Net income adjusted according to EPRA standards for European REITs.
kpis.description: EPRA earnings at €211 million, up 9% year-over-year.

kpis.name: EPRA earnings per share
kpis.explanation: Earnings per share adjusted according to EPRA standards.
kpis.description: EPRA EPS confirmed at €33.6, in line with expectations.
